sanity-hud.label: Sanity
darkness-attack.prompt.entered: Something is watching you from the darkness.
darkness-attack.prompt.warning: The darkness is about to strike!
darkness-attack.prompt.escaped: The darkness has lost your trail.
config.enable-sanity-system.name: Enable Sanity system
config.enable-sanity-system.tooltip: Enable the Sanity system and its gameplay effects.
config.sanity-monster-intensity.name: Sanity monster intensity
config.sanity-monster-intensity.tooltip: Choose how densely Sanity-related monsters may appear.
config.dark-hand-mode.name: Dark Hand behavior
config.dark-hand-mode.tooltip: Choose how Dark Hands interact with the world. Thief is a high-risk mode: it can permanently stop an eligible machine and permanently delete its current contents or ready output. Deleted contents cannot be recovered.
config.enable-sanity-visual-effects.name: Enable Sanity visual effects
config.enable-sanity-visual-effects.tool: Show local visual effects caused by changing Sanity.
config.darkness-damage-mode.name: Darkness damage mode
config.darkness-damage-mode.tooltip: Choose whether darkness damage is off, capped at a non-lethal floor, or uses the default behavior.
config.monster-difficulty-profile.name: Monster difficulty profile
config.monster-difficulty-profile.toolti: Choose a Beta balance profile. Stardew, Compatible, Don't Starve, and Fusion may currently use identical numeric values while balance data is unfinished.
config.enable-junimo-blessing.name: Enable Junimo blessing
config.enable-junimo-blessing.tooltip: Allow nearby Junimos to restore Sanity when the related behavior is active.
config.enable-dawn-dusk-music.name: Enable dawn/dusk music
config.enable-dawn-dusk-music.tooltip: Play Don't Starve-style dawn and dusk music when the in-game time changes.
passout.two-am.prompt-a: [DEV PLACEHOLDER] The darkness has noticed you.
passout.two-am.prompt-b: [DEV PLACEHOLDER] Something is moving just beyond the light.
passout.two-am.nonlethal-feedback: [DEV PLACEHOLDER] You barely hold on until morning.
passout.two-am.clinic-recovery: [DEV PLACEHOLDER] You wake up in Harvey's clinic.
passout.two-am.mail.body: [DEV PLACEHOLDER] You were brought to the clinic after being found unconscious last night. Please be more careful after dark. - Harvey[#]A note from Harvey
